messages.author: 988c500d49cca50a
messages.subject: 64 bit support
parts: I looked into R a few months ago for a work project but was blocked by the lack of support for 64 bit values.  Has this changed?

messages.author: 88275a537c4bd7d2
messages.subject: Re: 64 bit support
parts:
Yes, R (and RRO) has supported 64-bit data since R 3.0.0. See the section "Long vectors" under "Changes in R 3.0.0" at:

http://cran.r-project.org/doc/manuals/r-release/NEWS.html

# David Smith
